mapper.insert: INSERT INTO effect_outbox(id,claim_id,effect,payload,attempts,status,next_attempt_at) VALUES(#{id},#{claimId},#{effect},CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb),#{attempts},'pending',clock_timestamp()) ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id,claim_id,effect,payload::text payload,attempts,status,next_attempt_at FROM effect_outbox WHERE status IN ('pending','failed') AND next_attempt_at<=clock_timestamp() ORDER BY next_attempt_at,created_at LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE effect_outbox SET status='delivered',delivered_at=clock_timestamp(),last_error=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('pending','failed')
UPDATE effect_outbox SET attempts=attempts+1,status='failed',last_error=#{error},next_attempt_at=#{retryAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('pending','failed')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_requests(claim_id,request_id) VALUES(#{claimId},#{requestId}) ON CONFLICT(claim_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payment_requests WHERE claim_id=#{claimId})
